SELECT ag.auth_group_seq, ag.auth_group_cd, ag.auth_group_nm, ag.auth_group_desc, ag.use_yn FROM adm_auth_group ag WHERE 1=1
AND (ag.auth_group_nm LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR ag.auth_group_cd LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY ag.auth_group_seq

WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS ( SELECT m.menu_seq, m.up_menu_seq, m.menu_nm, m.menu_url, m.menu_type_cd, m.icon_class, m.sort_ord, m.use_yn, 1 AS tree_lvl, LPAD(COALESCE(m.sort_ord, 0)::text, 10, '0') || ':' || LPAD(m.menu_seq::text, 20, '0') AS sort_path FROM adm_menu_mst m WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND m.up_menu_seq IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.menu_seq, c.up_menu_seq, c.menu_nm, c.menu_url, c.menu_type_cd, c.icon_class, c.sort_ord, c.use_yn, p.tree_lvl + 1, p.sort_path || '/' || LPAD(COALESCE(c.sort_ord, 0)::text, 10, '0') || ':' || LPAD(c.menu_seq::text, 20, '0') FROM adm_menu_mst c JOIN menu_tree p ON p.menu_seq = c.up_menu_seq WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' ) SELECT mt.menu_seq, mt.up_menu_seq, mt.menu_nm, mt.menu_url, mt.menu_type_cd, mt.icon_class, mt.sort_ord, mt.use_yn, mt.tree_lvl, CASE WHEN COALESCE(aam.use_yn, 'N') = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(aam.perm_lvl, 0) ELSE 0 END AS perm_lvl, COALESCE(aam.use_yn, 'N') AS map_use_yn FROM menu_tree mt LEFT JOIN adm_auth_menu aam ON aam.auth_group_seq = #{authGroupSeq} AND aam.menu_seq = mt.menu_seq ORDER BY mt.sort_path
mapper.update: INSERT INTO adm_auth_menu ( auth_group_seq, menu_seq, perm_lvl, use_yn, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{auth_group_seq}, #{menu_seq}, #{perm_lvl}, #{use_yn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{created_by}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updated_by} ) ON CONFLICT (auth_group_seq, menu_seq) DO UPDATE SET perm_lvl = EXCLUDED.perm_lvl, use_yn = EXCLUDED.use_yn, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS ( SELECT m.menu_seq, m.up_menu_seq, m.menu_nm, m.menu_url, 1 AS tree_lvl, LPAD(COALESCE(m.sort_ord, 0)::text, 10, '0') || ':' || LPAD(m.menu_seq::text, 20, '0') AS sort_path FROM adm_menu_mst m WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND m.up_menu_seq IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.menu_seq, c.up_menu_seq, c.menu_nm, c.menu_url, p.tree_lvl + 1, p.sort_path || '/' || LPAD(COALESCE(c.sort_ord, 0)::text, 10, '0') || ':' || LPAD(c.menu_seq::text, 20, '0') FROM adm_menu_mst c JOIN menu_tree p ON p.menu_seq = c.up_menu_seq WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' ), user_groups AS ( SELECT agu.auth_group_seq FROM adm_auth_group_user agu WHERE agu.user_seq = #{userSeq} AND agu.use_yn = 'Y' UNION SELECT agd.auth_group_seq FROM adm_auth_group_dept agd JOIN adm_user_mst u ON u.user_seq = #{userSeq} AND u.dept_seq = agd.dept_seq WHERE agd.use_yn = 'Y' ), base_perm AS ( SELECT aam.menu_seq, MAX(COALESCE(aam.perm_lvl, 0)) AS base_perm_lvl FROM adm_auth_menu aam JOIN user_groups ug ON ug.auth_group_seq = aam.auth_group_seq WHERE aam.use_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY aam.menu_seq ), user_ex_ranked AS ( SELECT au.menu_seq, au.access_yn AS ex_access_yn, COALESCE(au.perm_lvl, 0) AS ex_perm_lvl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY au.menu_seq ORDER BY COALESCE(au.updated_at, au.created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) DESC ) AS rn FROM adm_auth_user au WHERE au.user_seq = #{userSeq} ), user_ex AS ( SELECT menu_seq, ex_access_yn, ex_perm_lvl FROM user_ex_ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT mt.menu_seq, mt.up_menu_seq, mt.menu_nm, mt.menu_url, mt.tree_lvl, COALESCE(bp.base_perm_lvl, 0) AS base_perm_lvl, ue.ex_access_yn AS ex_access_yn, COALESCE(ue.ex_perm_lvl, 0) AS ex_perm_lvl FROM menu_tree mt LEFT JOIN base_perm bp ON bp.menu_seq = mt.menu_seq LEFT JOIN user_ex ue ON ue.menu_seq = mt.menu_seq ORDER BY mt.sort_path
mapper.update: INSERT INTO adm_auth_user ( user_seq, menu_seq, access_yn, perm_lvl, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{user_seq}, #{menu_seq}, #{access_yn}, #{perm_lvl}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{created_by}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updated_by} ) ON CONFLICT (user_seq, menu_seq) DO UPDATE SET access_yn = EXCLUDED.access_yn, perm_lvl = EXCLUDED.perm_lvl, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
